description: Global Error Catalog - Error types, messages, and resolution guidance

errors.title: Module Not Found
errors.description: The application tried to import a module that doesn't exist or isn't properly exported.
causes: Package installed but not built (missing dist folder)
Subpath export not defined in package.json
resolution: Check that the package is in package.json dependencies
Run `pnpm install` from the monorepo root
Rebuild the package: `cd packages/<name> && pnpm build`
Verify the export exists in the package's package.json exports field
Check for typos in the import statement

errors.title: Export Not Found
errors.message: The requested module '{{modulePath}}' does not provide an export named '{{exportName}}'
errors.description: The module exists but doesn't export the requested symbol.
causes: Component/function was not exported from the module
Export was removed in a newer version
resolution: Check the package's index.ts for the export
Rebuild the package if source was recently changed
Check if the export was moved to a different subpath
Verify you're using the correct package version

example.error: does not provide an export named 'GazetteerRouter'

errors.title: Invalid Package Entry
errors.message: Failed to resolve entry for package "{{packageName}}". The package may have incorrect main/module/exports specified.
errors.description: The package.json exports field references files that don't exist in the dist folder.
causes: package.json exports reference .mjs but build outputs .js
Build config doesn't match exports config
resolution: Check what files exist in dist/ folder
Update package.json exports to match actual dist output
Ensure import uses .js and require uses .cjs
Rebuild the package after fixing config

example.error: Failed to resolve entry for package '@xala-technologies/gazetteer'

errors.title: Workspace Package Not Found
errors.message: "{{packageName}}@workspace:*" is in the dependencies but no package named "{{packageName}}" is present in the workspace
errors.description: A dependency references a workspace package that doesn't exist.
causes: Package was removed but dependency wasn't updated
resolution: List available packages: pnpm list --depth=0
Remove the non-existent package from dependencies
If package should exist, check pnpm-workspace.yaml includes its folder

example.solution: Remove from package.json dependencies (package doesn't exist)

errors.title: Network Request Failed
errors.description: An API request failed due to network issues or server error.
resolution: Verify the API server is running
Check the endpoint URL is correct
For CORS issues, configure server to allow the origin
Check browser Network tab for detailed error

example.error: Failed to fetch /api/tasks: 500 Internal Server Error
example.solution: Check API server logs for the error details

errors.title: Unauthorized Request
errors.description: The API request was rejected due to missing or invalid authentication.
resolution: Redirect user to login page
Refresh the authentication token
Check that auth headers are being sent

example.solution: Re-authenticate the user or refresh the session

errors.title: Access Forbidden
errors.description: The user is authenticated but doesn't have permission for this action.
causes: Feature not enabled for this subscription
resolution: Check user roles and permissions
Verify tenant context is correct
Contact admin to grant necessary permissions

example.solution: User needs 'admin' role to delete users

errors.title: Resource Not Found
resolution: Verify the resource ID is correct
Check if the resource was deleted
Confirm the API endpoint path is correct

example.solution: Task with ID 999 doesn't exist - redirect to task list

errors.title: Validation Error
errors.description: The request data failed server-side validation.
resolution: Check the validation errors for specific field issues
Update client-side validation to match server rules
Display field-level error messages to user

example.error: Validation failed: email is required, name must be at least 2 characters
example.solution: Show inline field errors and highlight invalid fields

errors.title: Component Render Error
errors.description: A React component threw an error during render.
resolution: Check the component for undefined access
Verify all required props are passed
Ensure necessary providers are in the component tree
Add error boundary around problematic component

example.solution: Add null check: items?.map() or use default empty array

errors.title: Missing Context Provider
errors.description: A hook is being used outside its required provider.
causes: Provider not added to component tree
Provider added below the component using the hook
resolution: Add the required provider above the component
Check provider hierarchy matches requirements
Verify importing from correct package

example.error: useGazetteer must be used within GazetteerProvider
example.solution: Wrap your app with GazetteerProvider at root level

errors.title: Hydration Mismatch
errors.message: Text content does not match server-rendered HTML
errors.description: The client-rendered output differs from server-rendered HTML.
causes: Using browser-only APIs during render (Date, window, localStorage)
Conditional rendering based on client state
Random values or timestamps in render
resolution: Use useEffect for browser-only logic
Ensure server and client render identical initial content
Use suppressHydrationWarning for intentional differences

example.solution: Format dates in useEffect, not during initial render

errors.title: Spec Not Found
errors.description: The requested page/route/flow spec doesn't exist.
causes: Spec file missing from gazetteer folder
Spec ID misspelled in route config
resolution: Check gazetteer/pages/ for the spec file
Verify spec ID matches in route and page files
Ensure specs are loaded on app init

errors.title: Invalid Spec Schema
errors.description: The spec file doesn't match the expected JSON schema.
resolution: Run spec validation: pnpm validate:specs
Check the schema for required fields
Use IDE with JSON schema support for validation

errors.title: Widget Not Registered
errors.description: The page spec references a widget type that isn't registered.
causes: Widget not added to component registry
resolution: Check component-registry.ts for registered widgets
Add widget to registry if it exists
Create the widget component if it doesn't exist

example.solution: Register TasksGrid in component-registry.ts or use registered type
